t: The Site Cleworth jacket is a lightweight, waterproof layer designed to keep the rain out. Made from a durable polyester fabric in a waterproof finish for changing weather conditions. Designed in a regular fit with hook and loop adjustable cuffs and elasticated hem for enhanced defence against the elements. Includes 2 lower pockets for storing essentials and a versatile pack-away hood collar. Features 50mm reflective tape on body and 30mm on arms to ensure maximum visibility in poor light conditions. Machine washable.
b: 50mm Reflective Tape on Body & 30mm Reflective Tape on Arms
